metadata.description: Claude Code plugins by Rami Ejleh that keep a human in the loop as the machine speeds up — installable from the ramiejleh/DefyAtrophy GitHub repo.

plugins.name: interactive-pr-review
plugins.description: Interactively review GitHub PRs (comments only) — Claude fetches the PR, writes a holistic overview, groups the diff into logical chunks with neutral descriptions, a 'things worth confirming' list, and inline insight bubbles explaining the code, presents them in a review UI with a sidebar and IDE-highlighted diffs (full diff per group), and posts your line- and file-level comments back to GitHub in one click.

plugins.name: walkthrough
plugins.description: Turns a feature into a paginated HTML walkthrough you read like a book. `/walkthrough the auth of this application` traces the flow, then builds a self-contained page: one step per page, real code excerpts in execution order with the relevant lines highlighted, and the explanation for each hidden behind a click — so you read the code and form your own understanding before checking it. Works on any existing code, whoever wrote it and whenever.
